rationale: ADR 0053 (owner directive 2026-09-25) asks SpecForge to file every FSMGen request the gap ledger evidences; each bundle adds three Markdown files (README, SIGNOFF, expected notes), and the ninth new bundle took the collection to 35 files against a 32-file ceiling while it used 1,930 of 16,384 lines and 131 KB of 1 MiB. Files rise to 96 (about 32 bundles); the byte and line totals rise to 96 times the unchanged per-file limits, as ADR 0032 requires.
